channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: New drone system which could spot wildfires before they get out of control completes its first test — but is it too late for the summer blazes plaguing Europe?
item.description: Israel tests AI wildfire-detection drone, although additional evaluations mean Europe will not benefit from it during this year's fire season.

item.title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
item.description: NextSlide says its team members are now working on ChatGPT.

item.title: Flock pitched turning Uber and Lyft drivers into a mobile surveillance network
item.description: A leaked document reveals the surveillance company planned to tap roughly 350,000 rideshare vehicles for data collection.

item.title: Pentagon launches campaign for unmanned boats able to launch drones at sea
item.description: The Pentagon launchs $100 million competition seeking autonomous vessels capable of deploying drones across contested maritime environments and patrol missions.

item.title: Pluton perd-elle son atmosphère ? Ce qu’une chute de pression de 16 % révèle vraiment
item.description: En utilisant, au cours de la dernière décennie, le phénomène des occultations stellaires pour surveiller l'état de l'atmosphère de Pluton depuis la Terre, une équipe d'astronomes est arrivée à la conclusion que celle-ci est en train de changer. Qu'est-ce que cela signifie ? Va-t-elle disparaître ?

item.title: Gmail is killing off one of its best features —and now I can't use it as my favorite email hub
item.description: Gmail won't play as nicely with other third-party email accounts as it used to, so I'll have to change my email habits.

item.title: The great privacy revolt: people are pushing back against the glasses that record, the earbuds that eavesdrop and the TVs watching our lives — here’s what we can do about it, according to an AI research CEO and a digital rights advocate
item.description: ‘This technology doesn’t need the cloud whatsoever, it’s simply cheaper and easier for manufacturers’ — why one expert thinks we’re overlooking the biggest privacy issue in the AI boom, and what a prolific digital rights advocate thinks needs to change

item.title: I've taken over 650 photos on the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Fold 8 Ultra, and I'd pick the 'worse' camera phone to use long-term — here's why
item.description: I've been testing both of Samsung's new expensive folding phones, and I'm surprised to say that the lesser has become my go-to camera phone.
